class_id.sh: bet365 class id (F1 10, golf 7, cycling 38, American football 12, baseball 16, ice hockey 17, basketball 18, rugby union 8, rugby league 19, Australian rules 36).

event_id.sh: bet365 event id (the drilled body's EV FI).

final_score.sh: The last scoreline seen (aggregate home-away; a comma-separated set list for set sports; for cricket bet365's Australian wickets/runs per innings in batting order, for example 7/199,8/141).

finished_at.sh: The last instant the match was seen live (≈ when it finished).

fixture_id.sh: The id that recorded this point.

handicap.sh: The handicap where applicable; same field as /odds.

in_play.sh: True while the match is actually under way.

kickoff_estimated.sh: True when kickoff_utc is not bet365's scheduled start but an estimate derived from the live feed (the instant the match was first seen live), used only when the real start is unknown.

market_count.sh: Markets priced for this match (unaffected by the groups filter).

n2.sh: Second participant where the market names one; same field as /odds.

note.sh: A short qualifier when the score alone is not enough, for example a tied ice-hockey final whose shoot-out or overtime winning goal is not part of bet365's score feed, or a cricket result by innings (bet365 lists innings in batting order,…

odds_frac.sh: Derived display fraction; odds_dec is authoritative.

overtime.sh: Present and true when the match was decided beyond regulation: the final period seen was overtime or a shoot-out, or (for ice hockey) the final score is level so an overtime or shoot-out settled it.

periods.sh: Per-period / per-set scores where the sport exposes them.

polled_at.sh: When this match was last refreshed.

score.sh: Live scoreline while in play, home-away.

side.sh: Selection side where the market uses one (e.g.

status.sh: finished: the match reached full time (a player or side won the required sets, baseball reached the 9th inning, or a cricket run result was derived).

last_fixture_seen_by_sport.sh: Per sport, the most recent time a fixture for that sport was seen in a catalog sweep.

warming.sh: True right after a restart while the board loads.

info.description:
MoviOdds serves exclusively bet365 odds for soccer, tennis, basketball, American football, ice hockey, baseball, rugby union and league, cricket and Australian rules (more sports being added): every market bet365 prices for a match, pre-match and in-play. Soccer is the default; pass sport=<key> (see the sport parameter), or sport=all, to /odds and /catalog for other sports. Load the board with GET /odds, then keep it current over the WebSocket at wss://moviodds.com/ws (send {"op":"subscribe"}, optionally with "fixtures" and "groups" lists; you receive a snapshot per match, then delta messages as prices change, and a remove message when a market closes or a match leaves the board). WebSockets are not describable in OpenAPI, so the stream is documented at https://moviodds.com/doc.

The odds feed needs no key. Only POST /betbuilder/price needs an API key (X-API-Key).

MoviOdds is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by bet365.
